verses.eng: "And thereafter the retributive receivers come and lead that soul out of the body. And thereafter the. retributive receivers spend three days circling round with that soul in all the regions and dispatch it to all the aeons of the world. And the counterfeiting spirit and the destiny follow that soul; and the power returns to the Virgin of Light.

"And after three days the retributive receivers lead down that soul to the Amente of the chaos; and when they bring it down to the chaos, they hand it over to those who chastize. And the retributive receivers return to their own regions according to the economy of the works of the rulers concerning the coming-forth of the souls.

"And the counterfeiting spirit becomes the receiver of the soul, being assigned to it and transferring it according to the chastisement because of the sins which it has made it commit, and is in great enmity to the soul.

"And when the soul has finished the chastisements in the chaos according to the sins which it has committed, the counterfeiting spirit leads it forth out of the chaos, being assigned to it and transferring it to every region because of the sins which it has committed; and it leads it forth on the way of the rulers of the midst. And when it reaches them, [the rulers] question it on the mysteries of the destiny; and if it has not found them, they question their destiny. And those rulers chastize that soul according to the sins of which it is guilty. I will tell you the type of their chastisements at the expansion of the universe.

How a sinful soul is brought back to birth. "When, therefore, the time of the chastisements of that soul in the judgments of the rulers of the midst shall be completed, the counterfeiting spirit leads the soul up out of all the regions of the rulers of the midst and brings it before the light of the sun according to the commandment of the First Man, Yew, and brings it before the judge, the Virgin of Light. And she proves that soul and finds that it is a sinning soul, and ceases her light-power into it for its upright and because of the body and the community of sense,--the type of which I will tell you at the expansion of the universe. And the Virgin of Light seals that soul and hands it over to one of her receivers and will have it cast into a body which is suitable to the sins which it has committed.

"And amen, I say to you: They will not discharge that soul from the changes of the body until it has yielded its last circuit according to its merit. Of all these then will I tell you their type and the type of the bodies into which it will be cast according to the sins of each soul. All this will I tell you when I shall have told you the expansion of the universe."

Of the ascension after death of the good soul that has received the mysteries. Jesus continued again in the discourse and said: "If on the contrary it is a soul which has not hearkened to the counterfeiting spirit in all its works, but has become good and has received the mysteries of the Light which are in the second space or even those which are in the third space which is within, when the time [of the coming-forth] of that soul out of the body is completed, then the counterfeiting spirit follows that soul, it and the destiny; and
it follows it on the way on which it will go above.

"And before it removes itself above, it utters the mystery of the undoing of the seals and all the bonds of the counterfeiting spirit with which the rulers have bound it to the soul; and when it is uttered, the bonds of the counterfeiting spirit undo themselves, and it ceases to come into that soul and releases the soul according to the commandments which the rulers of the great Fate have commanded it, saying: Release not this soul until it tell you the mystery of the undoing of all the seals with which we have bound you to the soul.'

"If then the soul shall have uttered the mystery of the undoing of the seals and of all the bonds of the counterfeiting spirit, and if it ceases to come into the soul and ceases to be bound to it, then it utters in that moment a mystery and releases the destiny to its region to the rulers who are on the way of the midst. And it utters the mystery and releases the counterfeiting spirit to the rulers of the Fate to the region in which it was bound to it.

"And in that moment it becomes a great light-stream, shining exceedingly, and the retributive receivers who have led it forth out of the body, are afraid of the light of that soul and fall on their faces. And in that moment that soul becomes a great light-stream, it becomes entirely wings of light, and penetrates all the regions of the rulers and all the orders of the Light, until it reaches the region of its kingdom up to which it has received mysteries.
"If on the other hand it is a soul which has

Of the state after death of one who has received the mysteries, and yet has transgressed. received mysteries in the first space which is without, and if after it has received the mysteries it has accomplished them, it [then] turns and commits sin after the accomplishing of the mysteries, and if the time of the coming-forth of that soul is completed, then the retributive receivers come to lead that soul out of the body.

"And the destiny and the counterfeiting spirit follow that soul. Because the counterfeiting spirit is bound to it with the seals and the bonds of the rulers, it follows thus that soul which travels on the ways with the counterfeiting spirit.

"It utters the mystery of the undoing of all the bonds and all the seals with which the rulers have bound the counterfeiting spirit to the soul. And when the soul utters the mystery of the undoing of the seals, straightway the bonds of the seals which are bound in the counterfeiting spirit to the soul undo themselves. And when the soul utters the mystery of the undoing of the seals, straightway the counterfeiting spirit undoes itself and ceases to be assigned to the soul. And in that moment the soul utters a mystery and restrains the counterfeiting spirit and the destiny and discharges them which follow it. But no one of them is in its power; but it is in their power.

"And in that moment the receivers of that soul come with the mysteries which it has received, come and snatch that soul out of the hands of the retributive receivers, and the [latter] receivers go back to the works of the rulers for the purpose of the economy of the leading-forth of the souls.

"And the receivers of that soul on the other hand who belong to the Light, become wings of light for that soul and become vestures of light for it and they do not lead it into the chaos, because it is not lawful to lead into the chaos souls which have received mysteries, but they lead it on the way of the rulers of the midst. And when it reaches the rulers of the midst, those rulers meet the soul, they being in great fear and violent fire and with different faces, in a word in great immeasurable fear.

"And in that moment the soul utters the mystery of their apology. And they are exceedingly afraid and fall on their faces, being in fear of the mystery which it has uttered, and of their apology. And that soul surrenders their destiny, saying to them: Take your destiny! The apology of the rulers of the ways of the midst. I come not to your regions from this moment onwards. I have become a stranger to you for ever, being about to go to the region of my inheritance.

"And when the soul shall have said this, the receivers of the Light fly with it on high and lead it into the aeons of the Fate, it giving every region its apology and its seals,--which I will tell you at the expansion of the universe. And it gives the counterfeiting spirit to the rulers and tells them the mystery of the bonds with which it is bound to it, and says to them: There have The apology of the rulers of the Fate. you your counterfeiting spirit! I come not to your region from this moment onwards. I have become a stranger to you for ever. And it gives every one his seal and his apology.
"And when the soul shall have said this, the receivers of the Light fly with it on high and lead

Of the ascension of that soul into the Inheritance. it out of the aeons of the Fate and lead it up into all the aeons [above], it giving to every region its apology and the apology of all the regions and the seals to the tyrants of the king, the Adamas. And it gives the apology of all the rulers of all the regions of the Left,--whose collective apologies and seals I will one day tell you when I shall tell you the expansion of the universe.

"And moreover those receivers lead that soul to the Virgin of Light and that soul gives the Virgin of Light the seals and the glory of the songs of praise. And the Virgin of Light and also the seven other virgins of the Light together prove that soul and find together their signs in it and their seals and their baptisms and their chrism. And the Virgin of Light seals that soul and the receivers of the Light baptize that soul and give it the spiritual chrism; and every one of the virgins of the Light seals it with her seals.

"And moreover the receivers of the Light hand it over to the great Tzabaawath, the Good, who is at the gate of the Life in the region of those of the Right, who is called Father.' And that soul gives him the glory of his songs of praise and his seals and his apologies. And Tzabaawath, the Great and Good, seals it with his seals. And the soul gives its science and the glory of the songs of praise and the seals to the whole region of those of the Right. They all seal it with their seals; and Melchisedec, the great Receiver of the Light who is in the region of those of the Right, seals that soul and all the receivers of Melchisedec seal that soul and lead it into the Treasury of the Light.
"And it gives the glory and the honour and

the laud of the songs of praise and. all the seals of all the regions of the Light. And all those of the region of the Treasury of the Light seal it with their seals and it goes to the region of the Inheritance."
When then the Saviour had said this to his disciples he said to them: Understand you in what manner I discourse with you?"

Marayam interprets from former sayings. And Marayam again started forward and said: "Yea, my Adanay, I understand in what manner you do discourse with me, and I will comprehend them all [ sc. your words]. Now, therefore,

concerning these words which you say, my mind has brought forward four thoughts in me and my lightman has led me and exulted and seethed, desiring to come forth out of me and enter into you. Now, therefore, my Adanay, hearken that I may tell you the four thoughts which have arisen in me.

"The first thought has arisen in me concerning the word which you have spoken: 'Now, therefore, the soul gives the apology and seal to all the rulers who are in the region of the king, the Adamas, and gives the apology and the honour and the glory of all their seals and the songs of praise to the region of the Light,'--concerning this word then you have spoken to us aforetime, when they brought you the piece of The piece of money which was brought to Jesus. money and you did see that it was of silver and copper and did ask: 'Whose is this image?' They said: 'The king's.' And when you saw that it was of silver and copper mixed, you said: Give therefore the king's to the king and Alahayam's to God,'--that is: If the soul receives mysteries, it gives the apology to

all the rulers and to the region of the king, the Adamas; and the soul gives the honour and the glory to all those of the region of the Light. And the word: 'It has glistened, when you did see that it is made up of silver and copper,'--it is the type thereof, that in it [ sc. the soul] is the power of the Light, which is the refined silver, and that in it is the counterfeiting spirit, which is the material copper. This, my Adanay, is the first thought.

"The second thought is on the other hand that which you have just said to us concerning the soul which receives the mysteries: 'If it comes into the region of the rulers of the way of the midst, they come forth to meet it in exceedingly great fear and they are afraid of it. And the soul gives the mystery of the fear to them and they are afraid before it. And it gives the destiny to its region, and it gives the counterfeiting spirit to its own region, and it gives the apology and the seals to every one of the rulers who are on the ways, and it gives the honour and the glory and the laud of the seals and the songs of praise to all those of the region of the Light,'--concerning this word, my Adanay, you have spoken aforetime through the mouth of our brother An saying of Shaawal. Shaawal: Give tax to whom tax is due, give fear to whom fear is due, give tribute to whom tribute is due, give honour to whom honour is due, and give laud to whom laud is due, and owe not any other anything,' --that is, my Adanay: The soul which receives mysteries, gives apology to all regions. This, my Adanay, is the second thought.
"The third thought on the other hand concerning the word which you have aforetime spoken

The foes of one's own house. to us: 'The counterfeiting spirit is hostile to the soul, making it do all sins and all mischiefs, and it transfers it in the chastisements because of all the. sins which it has made it commit; in a word, it is hostile to the soul in every way,'--concerning this word, therefore, you have said to us aforetime: 'The foes of the man are the dwellers in his house,'--that is: The dwellers in the house of the soul are the counterfeiting spirit and the destiny, which are hostile to the soul the whole time, making it commit all sin and all iniquities. Lo this, my Adanay, is the third thought.

"The fourth thought on the other hand concerning the word which you have said: 'If the soul goes forth out of the body and travels on the way with the counterfeiting spirit, and if it has not found the mystery of the undoing of all the bonds and the seals which are bound to the counterfeiting spirit, so that it may cease to haunt or be assigned to it,--if it then has not found it, the counterfeiting spirit leads the soul to the Virgin of Light, the judge; and the judge, the Virgin of Light, proves the soul and finds that it has sinned and, as she also has not found the mysteries of the Light with it, she hands it over to one of her receivers, and her receiver leads it and casts it into the body, and it comes not out of the changes of the body before it has yielded its last circuit,'--concerning this word, then, my Adanay, you have said to us aforetime: 'Be reconciled with your foe as long A former saying concerning rebirth. as you are on the way with him, lest perchance your foe hand you over to the judge and the judge hand you over to the servant and the servant
cast you into prison, and you shall not come forth out of that region till you have yielded the last farthing.'

"Because of this manifestly is your word: Every soul which comes forth out of the body and travels on the way with the counterfeiting spirit and finds not the mystery of the undoing of all the seals and all the bonds, so that it may undo itself from the counterfeiting spirit which is bound to it,--that soul which has not found mysteries of the Light and has not found the mysteries of detachment from the counterfeiting spirit which is bound to it,--if then it has not found it, the counterfeiting spirit leads that soul to the Virgin of Light, and the Virgin of Light, yea that judge, hands over that soul to one of her receivers, and her receiver casts it into the sphere of the aeons, and it comes not out of the changes of the body before it has yielded the last circuit which is appointed for it. This then, my Adanay, is the fourth thought."
It came to pass then, when Jesus had heard Marayam say these words, that he said: Well said, blessed Marayam, spiritual one]. These are the solutions of the words which I have spoken."

Marayam continues to question Jesus. Marayam answered and said: "Still, my Adanay, do I question you, because from now on I will begin to question you on all things with sureness. For this cause, therefore, my Adanay, be patient with us and reveal to us all things on which we shall question you for the sake of the manner, how my brethren are to herald it to the whole race of men."
And when she had said this to the Saviour,

the Saviour answered and said to her in great compassion towards her: "Aman, amen, I say to you: Not only will I reveal to you all things on which you shall question me, but from now on I will reveal to you other things on which you have not thought to question, which have not entered into the heart of man, and which also all the gods, who are below man, know not. Now, therefore, Marayam, question on what you may question, and I will reveal it to you face to face without similitude."
